These are AC-2609-001 to 009, 012 to 015, 018 to 021, and 023 to 026. Software licences (NT-2026-31877) were excluded from check 3, as were freight, delivery and installation lines.
ambiguities: Total credited: the journal footer gives 150,308.27, which is net of the 620.00 credit note; gross credits are 150,928.27. Northstar NYS-2026-114 is an emergency repair: it was not ordered by PO, so check 3 does not apply. QMR also shows booked VAT that does not appear on its invoice; it is reported under check 2 only.
